name: wonderbox
description: WonderBox — monthly physical learning kits for children aged 5-12 with a screen-free audio companion.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @wonderbox/hardware-protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace @wonderbox/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @wonderbox/hardware-protocol && npm run test --workspace @wonderbox/web
scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/env-init.mjs && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
